name: NVIDIA
tagline: The AI chip champion, knocked down by a sudden CEO exit.
weaknesses: CEO Jensen Huang resigned in November; succession unclear
Customers concentrated in a few hyperscalers
thesis: Quarterly revenue of about $115.8B beat estimates on Nov 17
Shares are roughly 30% below their October level, so the price now reflects more fear
The franchise (chips + software + networking) does not depend on one person
moat: Switching costs and ecosystem: CUDA, libraries and developer habits make rivals hard to swap in. Durable for years, though AMD and custom chips chip away at the edges.
outlook: Demand still looks strong based on the latest quarter. The big unknown is leadership: who runs the company and whether strategy or culture changes. Expect volatility until a permanent CEO is named.
news: Reported a quarter that topped estimates after the close on Nov 17 and rose after hours, following weeks of selling after Huang's resignation.
changeMind: A credible permanent CEO named quickly would firm up the call
Guidance cut or falling data-center orders would drop it to Hold
entryNote: Building in stages makes sense while leadership is unsettled.
